issue_title: [Bug] _ensure_parent_directory TOCTOU race: parent check and mkdir not atomic
fix_summary: Fixed TOCTOU race condition in _ensure_parent_directory by replacing check-then-act pattern with exist_ok=True and proper exception handling

implementation_details.before: Used if not parent.exists() check followed by parent.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
implementation_details.after: Uses parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True) with try/except FileExistsError handling
implementation_details.root_cause: Race condition between exists() check and mkdir() call where another process could create the directory
implementation_details.solution: Eliminate the check entirely by using exist_ok=True, and only raise ValueError if the path exists as a file instead of a directory

acceptance_criteria_met: Concurrent save() calls to the same new path do not raise OSError/FileExistsError
If another process creates a file at parent path, clear ValueError is raised
risks: None - the change is backwards compatible and only changes error handling behavior
